mapper.select: SELECT a.dict_name, a.dict_code FROM sys_dict a LEFT JOIN sys_dict b ON a.parent_id = b.id WHERE b.dict_code = #{code}
select t.${tableDict.valueColumn} as dict_code, t.${tableDict.nameColumn} as dict_name from ${tableDict.tableName} t

select t.${tableDict.parentId} as parent_id, t.${tableDict.valueColumn} as dict_code, t.${tableDict.nameColumn} as dict_name, ${tableDict.leafColumn} as leaf from ${tableDict.tableName} t
t.${tableDict.parentId} = '${tableDict.parentValue}'

select t.${parentId} as parent_id, t.${valueColumn} as dict_code, t.${nameColumn} as dict_name, ${leafColumn} as leaf from ${tableName} t
t.${parentId} = '${parentValue}'
select t.${tableDict.valueColumn} as dict_code, t.${tableDict.nameColumn} as dict_name from ${tableDict.tableName} t where ${tableDict.valueColumn} = #{code}
